body.name: Two Bedroom/Two and a Half Bath

photos.name: 01d.jpg
photos.alt_text: A spacious, modern living area featuring light gray walls and a wood-like laminate floor. There is a doorway leading to a kitchen area with a counter and a refrigerator visible. The room is well-lit with a circular ceiling light, and there are two doors leading to other rooms.

photos.name: 04a.jpg
photos.alt_text: A spacious, empty room with light gray walls and a ceiling fan. The floor features dark wood-like laminate. A window with horizontal blinds allows natural light in, revealing a view of an exterior structure. The room has no furniture, providing a blank canvas for various uses.

photos.name: 05b.jpg
photos.alt_text: A clean and modern bathroom featuring a bathtub with a showerhead, a white sink cabinet with a countertop, a large mirror above the sink, and light grey walls. The space is well-lit and has a simple, minimalist design.

photos.name: 08.jpg
photos.alt_text: A close-up view of a white washing machine in a light-colored laundry room. The machine has a control panel with knobs for settings, and the wall is plain with a smooth finish.

photos.name: 04c.jpg
photos.alt_text: A clean and modern bathroom featuring a white shower and bathtub combo, a simple countertop with a sink, a mirror above the sink, and light grey walls. The floor has a wood-like appearance, and there's a toilet visible near the wall. Natural light is coming in from an adjacent room.

photos.name: 01a.jpg
photos.alt_text: A spacious, empty room with light gray walls and wooden flooring. It features an open layout, with a doorway leading to another area, a small opening to a kitchen, and a white door on the right. Natural light brightens the space, creating a clean and inviting atmosphere.

photos.name: 01c.jpg
photos.alt_text: Spacious, empty room featuring light gray walls and wooden flooring. A window with white blinds allows natural light to enter, illuminating the space. There are no furnishings or decorations, creating a clean and minimalist atmosphere. Ideal for customization or renovation.

photos.name: 02.jpg
photos.alt_text: A modern kitchen featuring white cabinetry, a stove with four burners, a dishwasher, and a large refrigerator. The space is well-lit with a ceiling light and has a neutral color palette, creating a clean and bright atmosphere. The countertops are light-colored, enhancing the overall spacious feel.

photos.name: 04b.jpg
photos.alt_text: A spacious, empty room with light gray walls and a wooden floor. The room has a ceiling fan with wooden blades, and there are four white doors along the walls, suggesting multiple entrances or closets. Natural light brightens the room, creating a clean and airy atmosphere.

photos.name: 05a.jpg
photos.alt_text: A spacious room with wooden flooring, featuring a ceiling fan, light-colored walls, and large windows allowing natural light. One wall showcases a prominent slanted section. There are electrical outlets, and the overall ambiance is bright and inviting.

photos.name: 06.jpg
photos.alt_text: Empty room with light gray walls and wooden flooring. A window with blinds allows natural light to enter, creating a bright atmosphere. Ceiling fan visible above, adding a modern touch to the space. The overall ambiance is clean and minimalistic, ideal for various decorating styles.
